title: Edit the account password change form
steps: Pause on the Password form before editing either password field.
Type "abc" into New password, then use its Show password control.
Fill Old password with the account's current password while keeping abc in New password, then view Update.
Clear Old password and enter NextPass123! in New password, then view Update.
Fill Old password again while keeping NextPass123!, then view Update without submitting.

video_guide.summary: Update remains disabled in the three invalid input states and becomes enabled only when both fields satisfy the form requirements. No password change is submitted.

chapters.note: Old password is empty and abc is revealed; a minimum-length error appears and Update is disabled.

chapters.label: Fill the old password with the short replacement

chapters.note: Filling Old password does not make abc valid; Update remains disabled.

chapters.label: Leave old password empty with a valid replacement

chapters.note: NextPass123! is entered with Old password empty; Update remains disabled.

chapters.label: Fill both passwords with a valid replacement

chapters.note: Old password is filled and NextPass123! remains revealed; Update is enabled.
